$comment: Golden oracle for deterministic round-robin schedule generation (FR-041, FR-047, BR-102, NFR-018). Single round-robin via the circle method: player counts and pairings below are canonical. Ordering within a pair is irrelevant (a match is unordered) but home/away/slot ordering MUST be deterministic given the stored inputs.
invariants: every unordered pair of participants appears exactly once (single round)
each participant plays exactly once per round
for odd N, each round has exactly one participant on a bye; each participant byes exactly once across the N rounds
for even N, there are N-1 rounds and no byes

cases.name: N=5 (odd, 5 rounds, 10 matches, 1 bye per round)

doubleRoundRobinNote: For a double round-robin (config), repeat every pairing once more (swapping home/away where applicable); match count doubles to N*(N-1) and each pair appears exactly twice (BR-102).
